brief: Two bins to sort my dead AA batteries for recycling.

requirements.evidence: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full and bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full — two full-depth bins side by side
Two identical open full bins side by side for sorting (e.g. one per chemistry/brand); no battery props exist in catalog so shown empty
Open bins hold spent cells for drop-off; no waterproofing/leak containment claimed — configurator checks fit only

finish.summary: Two full-depth bins on a 2-cell base, capped and locked. Use one bin per sort (e.g. alkaline vs rechargeable) and empty to recycling.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
